info.title: LifeLink coordination backend
info.description: A coordination prototype for The Gambia. Verification is not medical clearance; compatibility does not replace crossmatching; location freshness is not presence; donation pause is operational policy. Only in-app notifications are implemented. Examples are fictional. No arbitrary public donor matching/search API exists.
